label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Concerns
items.text: PGA Tour players told CEO Brian Rolapp they don’t want more than three consecutive weeks, citing the back-to-back Florida events before the Masters that could cause stars to skip Bay Hill.

items.headline: Muirfield Village’s Brutal Challenge
items.text: An eight-handicap golfer shot 92 at Muirfield Village, matching the worst Memorial score ever, highlighting the course’s extreme difficulty even for good amateurs.

items.headline: Nicklaus Criticizes On-Course Interviews
items.text: Jack Nicklaus said he 'can’t stand' mid-round interviews, referencing Ben Griffin’s interrupted shot and joking that Ben Hogan would have reacted harshly to such distractions.
